requirement.description: The View class incorrectly handles target validation, causing TypeError when target is not a data view. Tests fail with "Object (sig v) is not a data view" when constructing Views with Signals.
requirement.contract: When a View is constructed with a target, that target must be either a data view (including Signals) or a value-castable object that can be converted to a Value. The View constructor should properly validate and handle Signal targets.

requirement.description: The View.__getitem__ method has incorrect validation for array layout indexing. It raises TypeError when trying to index array layouts with values, but should allow such indexing.
requirement.contract: When accessing array layouts via __getitem__, if the key is a Value or ValueCastable object, it should create a part selection instead of raising TypeError. Only non-array layouts should raise TypeError for Value-based indexing.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method has incorrect error message formatting for missing fields. It uses wrong format string and doesn't provide proper suggestions for similar field names.
requirement.contract: When accessing a non-existent field via __getattr__, the error message should correctly format the target object representation and provide helpful suggestions for similar field names.

requirement.description: The Enum.const method has incorrect behavior when handling enum values. It should accept both enum members and integer values but currently fails with certain combinations.
requirement.contract: The Enum.const method should properly handle both integer values and enum member instances, converting them to appropriate constants with the correct shape.

requirement.description: The Signal.__init__ method has incorrect reset validation logic for enum shapes. It doesn't properly handle reset values for enum-shaped signals and raises TypeError incorrectly.
requirement.contract: When creating a Signal with an enum shape, the reset value should be validated to be a valid member of that enum, and appropriate error messages should be provided for invalid values.
